name: openpool
description: A self-hosted, Cloudflare-native object storage control plane.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@openpool/web && npm run build --workspace=@openpool/worker
scripts.deploy: npm run build --workspace=@openpool/web && npm run deploy --workspace=@openpool/worker
scripts.deploy:with-migrations: npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run deploy
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build

ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: Generate a high-entropy one-time administrator bootstrap token.

CREDENTIAL_MASTER_KEY.description: Generate exactly 32 random bytes and encode them as canonical base64. Never rotate this value until credential re-encryption exists.

API_KEY_PEPPER.description: Generate a separate 32-byte canonical base64 secret used only for API key HMAC hashing.
